sources.entry: LumaRing - Radial menu for switching apps, windows, and browser tabs. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/potatoQi/LumaRing) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: LumaRing is a small native macOS radial-menu app for switching between apps, windows, and browser tabs and running app shortcuts.
summary.what_it_does: LumaRing shows a small ring-shaped radial menu on macOS for switching between applications, individual windows, and browser tabs. It can also run app shortcuts from the same menu. The README describes it as a lightweight, responsive tool built natively in Swift. The app download is about 2.9 MB. Installation is documented via Homebrew cask or GitHub Releases, and it supports both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later. The README is brief and does not describe configuration options or detailed usage steps.
use_cases: switch between open apps on mac
jump between windows with a radial menu
run app shortcuts from a menu on macos
lightweight replacement for the default app switcher
how_to_run: Or download the app from GitHub Releases
notable: Radial ring menu for switching apps, windows, and browser tabs
